headline_corrections.claim: game+5B0h and game+5BCh are std::list walks
headline_corrections.evidence: 004b9f40 and 004bf830 are _Tree::iterator::operator++: right-subtree minimum else climb while the node is the right child, reading _Left +0h, _Parent +4h, _Right +8h and _Isnil at +11h / +25h. begin() is _Myhead->_Left at 004e4e72 and 004e4ef9. 004d41a0 is the matching erase(first,last) whose whole-range fast path resets _Myhead->_Left/_Parent/_Right to _Myhead and _Mysize to 0 at 004d41f2..004d4204.

headline_corrections.claim: 004d11d0 is an STL length-error throw site (tag stl_throw_site)
headline_corrections.correction: 004d11d0 is std::_Tree::erase(iterator) for the N28 instantiation.
headline_corrections.evidence: Three arguments are the hidden return-iterator pointer plus one checked iterator by value (_Mycont, _Ptr), matching push edi; push ebx; lea edx,[esp+38h]; push edx at 004e4fd2. It calls 004bf830 to build the successor it returns. The string immediate at 00ce44e0 is 'invalid map/set<T> iterator', the MSVC debug message for a bad erase iterator.

routines.name: STL_Tree_EraseIter_IntKey_N28_004d11d0
routines.abi: __thiscall(this = tree, iterator* result, iterator by value {_Mycont, _Ptr}), RET 0Ch

routines.effect: 00f876a4 = float argument, 00f876a8 = the same, 00f876b0 = (int)(argument / 0.05) via the double at 00d7a270 and ftol 00bf7420

steps: walk game+5B0h; for each int value call 00a91e20 on records + id*30h, advancing with 004b9f40
004e4eda: when game+5C4h is non-zero reset one more record; the literal 30h at 004e4eeb makes it action index 1
walk game+5BCh; the iterator is advanced at 004e4f4b before the node is used, so the erase at 004e4fdf cannot invalidate it
per node: +20h clear -> 00a92aa0(node+10h, node+18h) then latch +20h; otherwise 00a919f0(node+10h)
004e4fbf..004e4fcc: keep while 00f876a4 < node+14h, erase through 004d11d0 otherwise

uncertainties: What 00f876a4 measures is not settled. Its only writer is 00874640 at 0087464c, and all five call sites read (004e0194, 007714e7, 00771fdc, 006b5a85, 004da780) pass 0.0f. Other readers add it as a bias (008e9dbc, 008e9e3c, 008e9f1a). With only those writes the erase rule reduces to 'erase unless the threshold is positive'.
The comparator for either tree was not read, so the visit order of both sets is unknown; the reconstruction preserves insertion order.
No insertion site for the game+5BCh tree was found, so the parameter block's object at +0h and the fixed guard index 1 stay unexplained.
00a91a50's branch structure is only partly recovered.
00425850, the holdPress query on the parameter block, is outside this packet; the reconstruction decides it from the block's name string.
Record fields +0h, +02h..+0Fh and +18h..+1Bh were not read.

reconstruction.host: bsp::InputTickHost, one virtual per native call the packet cannot reconstruct: backend_update, take_backend_bindings_dirty, rebind_all_actions, poll_action_bindings, listener_classify, post_update_hook
